rules.title: How the fair works
rules.l1: Every Monday a new week starts at ☀️ 0
rules.l2: Top 3 take the blue, red and yellow ribbons
rules.l3: Top 20% move up to a sunnier bed, bottom 20% move to the shaded one
rules.l4: Nothing is lost — your garden, coins and streak stay

unavailable: The fair opens once the database is updated. Check back in a moment.
